turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.

The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com.
Thank you. I have passed your case on to a colleague, who will take over the conversation and review the closed damage claim on order SC-3072 with you.

input.summary: Customer Patrick Okonkwo (email patrick.okonkwo@example.com, order SC-3072) rejects staff's decision that closed his earlier damage claim.
